selected_activity:
Activity: Evidence-Based Case Dilemma Audit: Competency Level 8.1.2 (Period 1 of 3)
Approach: Teams analyze real-world civic dilemma cards reflecting 'Names the public services provided for the area identifying them.'. They investigate institutional duties versus citizen responsibilities.
Student task: Examine case scenarios, highlight legal/civic duties, and compile evidence on a grievance matrix.
Teacher facilitation: Provides scaffolding questions to guide student reasoning from facts to solutions.
Expected output: Completed Civic Rights and Duties Inquiry Matrix.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
